name: al-agentic-dev
description: Agentic AL/Business Central development: composable skills (al-steer, al-grill-adr, al-design, al-scope, al-refine, al-implement, al-refactor, al-mutate, al-second-opinion, al-research) with two persistent layers: repo-root memory (CONTEXT.md, docs/adr/, .out-of-scope/) and branch-scoped feature state (architecture.md + tasks.md). Replaces complex multi-agent workflows with focused single-purpose skills, standard BC vocabulary, and KISS/YAGNI principles. BREAKING in 0.12.0: tasks.md, architecture.md, and ADR formats reshaped for human readability (collapsibles, GFM alerts, Mermaid graphs, Considered Options table, em-dash ban). Mid-feature upgrades require regenerating tasks.md via /al-scope; finish in-flight work on the prior version, or convert manually.
